purpose: Teach: 出撃/前途/可否/押え/広義/互角/前段/奔走

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、学会発表で出撃するつもりで臨め
lines.en: Ren — approach this conference presentation like you're going into battle.
lines.style: Direct, measured authority. Leans forward slightly. The tone of someone who expects capability and won't soften the challenge. Each phrase deliberate, no wasted breath.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究者として前途を切り開きます
lines.en: Yes. I'll open new ground as a researcher.
lines.style: Straight spine, respectful. Meeting his gaze. The earnestness is genuine but not theatrical — this is how Ren speaks when he means something.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究テーマの可否を指導教員と相談しろ
lines.en: Ren — consult with your advisor about whether your research topic is viable.
lines.style: Practical instruction, no room for drift. Eyes steady. The kind of directive that sounds like care when it comes from someone you trust.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。実験予算を押え込む工夫をします
lines.en: Yes. I'll find ways to control the experimental budget.
lines.style: Nod of assent, already mentally pivoting. A touch anxious underneath — aware he's committing to something. Quiet determination.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、広義の研究分野も視野に入れろ
lines.en: Ren — widen your lens. Look beyond the narrow field.
lines.style: Slight pause before 'widen' — giving weight to the expansion he's asking for. Warm underneath the authority. This is mentorship, not bureaucracy.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。海外研究者と互角に議論できる力を養います
lines.en: Yes. I'll develop the ability to debate with researchers overseas as equals.
lines.style: Respectful but not deferential. There's quiet ambition here. Head slightly raised. The words come from genuine intention, not rote politeness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文の前段で問いを明確にしろ
lines.en: Ren — before the paper, make your central question crystal clear.
lines.style: Leans back slightly. Settling into the weight of the instruction. This one lands as the core thing. Deliberate pace. Eyes don't leave him.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。実験補助探しに奔走しております
lines.en: Yes. I'm already out looking for lab assistants.
lines.style: Quick acknowledgment with an undertone of managed stress. Slightly breathless — already in motion. Shows he's taking action, not just promising. Honest fatigue showing at the edges.
